summary: A 1934 L-4 cab on a 10-foot pole tower in the Kootenai National Forest, unused for years, wrapped against a 1994 fire and found standing but needing repairs in 2023.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 10-foot pole tower

access.note: No rental or official visitor status found. Reached by a flagged route after a 30-mile dirt-road drive; no road to the site.

visit.trail_note: Flagged route after a 30-mile drive on dirt road (2023 NMLA report). Sources do not say the cab is open to visitors.

events.note: First used as a camp lookout
Present 10-foot pole tower with L-4 cab
Yaak-Red Dragon Complex Fire threatened the tower; the cab was wrapped for protection
Volunteer visit: catwalk, steps, railings and shutters need repair; roof has holes; cab interior in good shape

notes_for_editor: Record's 2023 event cites nwmt-ffla.org/2023/09/01/2023-projects/, whose cached text is an empty shell; the Lost Horse assessment is in the NMLA 2023 Year-End Report PDF (source 2), so that source URL should be updated. Elevation differs: NHLR gives 6,523 ft (1,988 m), firelookout.com 6,558 ft; the record keeps the NHLR value. The access level 'restricted' is my reading of the flagged-route and no-road descriptions, not an official status; check with the Kootenai NF. No source gives the abandonment year or any staffing.
